name: 鹞子马场
Hawk's Paddock
before: 一片开阔的草滩上，鹞子的马队正在操练：楔子阵，一声呼哨分成两股，再一声又合拢，比边军还像边军。马场边上插着一块旧马牌，「河西骑营」。可到了半夜，这些操练得整整齐齐的战马会一匹匹挣脱缰绳，跑去阳关外头跪着，骑手们追都追不回来。

On an open grassland the Hawk's horsemen drill in a tidy wedge, splitting at one whistle and closing at the next, more soldierly than real soldiers. An old horse tag on a post reads 'Hexi Cavalry'. Yet at midnight these well-drilled warhorses break their tethers one by one and run off to kneel outside Yangguan, and their riders can't bring them back.
after: 马队被冲散了。被俘的老骑手说，鹞子年轻时是河西骑营的伍长，营散了才落草。这些马里有十几匹是当年千里号的驮马，商队进沙海前卸了货留下的。「它们一跪，」老骑手说，「营里别的马也跟着跪。马是跟着领头的。」

The horsemen are routed. A captured old rider says the Hawk was a squad leader in the Hexi Cavalry before it was disbanded and he took to the hills. A dozen of these horses were the Qianli caravan's pack animals, unloaded and left behind before it entered the Sand Sea. 'When they kneel,' he says, 'the rest of the herd kneels too. Horses follow their leaders.'

name: 会盟沙
Council Sands
before: 沙地上围着一圈篝火，七八伙沙匪的头领聚在一起喝血酒，秃狼坐在上首，要大家推他当新的大头领。他拍着桌子说，鹞子病得起不来了，谁跟他打下阳关，鹞子仓就是谁的。几个头领为座次吵得拔刀相向，秃狼正得意。

A ring of bonfires on the sand: chiefs from seven or eight gangs are drinking blood-wine, with Bald Wolf at the head demanding they elect him their new great chief. The Hawk is too sick to rise, he says, banging the table, and whoever helps him take Yangguan gets the Hawk's storehouse. A few chiefs are drawing blades over the seating. Bald Wolf is pleased with himself.
after: 你们冲进篝火圈，一锅端了。秃狼骑着马跑了，跑的方向是阳关北边的鹞子仓。被俘的头领们垂头丧气，有一个嘟囔着：「鹞子都没倒，我们急什么。」另一个说：「秃狼说鹞子在等一个人，等到了，他就撑不住了。」

You charge into the ring of fire and sweep them all up. Bald Wolf escapes on horseback, heading for the Hawk's storehouse north of Yangguan. The captured chiefs sit dejected. One mutters: 'The Hawk hasn't even fallen. What were we rushing for?' Another says: 'Bald Wolf says the Hawk's waiting for someone. Once they come, he'll give way.'

name: 缚驼营
Tethered Camel Camp
before: 离阳关只剩几十里，这里驻着鹞子的亲兵，营里的骆驼都用粗绳子拴着腿，拴得死死的。亲兵们说，不拴不行：一到半夜，这些骆驼就挣开缰绳，齐刷刷跪到鹞子的大帐外面，头朝西，怎么赶都不起来。亲兵们个个熬红了眼，脾气暴躁。

Only a few dozen li from Yangguan, the Hawk's personal guard is camped here, and every camel's legs are bound tight with thick rope. They have to be, the guards say: at midnight the camels break free and kneel in rows outside the Hawk's tent, heads to the west, and won't get up for anything. The guards are red-eyed from lack of sleep and short-tempered.
after: 亲兵营被打垮了。你们解开一峰骆驼的绳子，它站起来，慢慢走到营地西头，朝着阳关跪下，一动不动。它背上的鞍子是空的，鞍绳却系得整整齐齐，像是随时等着人来装货。一个亲兵叹气：「十年了，它们在等鹞子还一样东西。」

The guard camp is broken. You untie one camel; it rises, walks slowly to the western edge of the camp, and kneels facing Yangguan. Its saddle is empty, but the girth ropes are neatly tied, as if waiting at any moment to be loaded. A guard sighs: 'Ten years. They're waiting for the Hawk to give something back.'

name: 回声洼
Echo Hollow
before: 沙地里一个大洼，四壁陡直，一喊话回音能响好几遍。洼里传出一片喊杀声，听着像有上百人，秃狼派来的一队人马在洼口犹豫了半天，不敢进。你们壮着胆子走进去，喊杀声更响了，还夹着一句：「鹞子在，阳关不乱！」

A great hollow in the sand with steep walls, where a shout echoes back several times. A din of war cries rises from it, like a hundred men, and a detachment sent by Bald Wolf has dithered at the mouth for ages, afraid to enter. You steel yourselves and walk in, and the shouting grows louder, with one line ringing through it: 'While the Hawk stands, Yangguan holds!'
after: 打完一看，洼里只有五个鹞子的老弟兄，嗓子全喊哑了。他们奉命守着去阳关的后路，人少，只好靠回音吓人。知道你们是千字旗，五个人对视一眼，让开了路：「鹞子说过，你们来，就让你们过。」

Once it's over there turn out to be only five of the Hawk's old hands in the hollow, all hoarse. They were ordered to hold the back road to Yangguan, and too few to fight, they frightened people with echoes. Learning you fly the Qian banner, the five exchange a look and stand aside. 'The Hawk said: when you come, let you through.'

name: 醉卧坡
Drunken Slope
before: 一支往阳关集送葡萄酒的商队在这里被秃狼的人劫了，劫道的打开酒桶，一喝就是三天。坡上横七竖八躺满了人，有的抱着酒桶打呼，有的拿着刀对着天大骂鹞子。酒商被绑在一边，看着自家的酒一桶桶见底，心疼得眼泪直流。

A wine caravan bound for the Yangguan market was robbed here by Bald Wolf's men, who opened the casks and have been drinking for three days. Bodies lie sprawled across the slope, some snoring with their arms round casks, some waving blades at the sky and cursing the Hawk. The merchant, tied up to one side, weeps as cask after cask runs dry.
after: 醉醺醺的人连刀都握不稳，没打几下就倒了一片。酒商被放了，还剩七桶。一个醉汉被你们泼醒，迷迷糊糊地说漏了嘴：秃狼要先抢鹞子仓，再拿仓里的东西去收买阳关的老弟兄。「可那些老东西不认钱，」他打了个酒嗝，「只认鹞子。」

The drunks can't hold their blades and fall in heaps. The freed merchant has seven casks left. A drunk you douse awake lets slip, still fuddled: Bald Wolf means to take the storehouse first, then buy over Yangguan's old hands with what's inside. 'But those old fossils don't care about money,' he hiccups. 'Only the Hawk.'

name: 赦书沙
Pardon Sands
before: 沙地上两伙人正为一卷黄绢打得不可开交。那是朝廷随开拓队一起发下来的赦书：凡关外落草者，能助开拓队西行的，一律赦罪。秃狼的人要烧了它，说「赦了还怎么抢」；鹞子的老弟兄要护着它，说「这是我们回家的路」。

Two gangs are fighting furiously over a scroll of yellow silk on the sand. It's the pardon the court sent out with the pioneers: any outlaw beyond the pass who helps the pioneers on their way west is forgiven. Bald Wolf's men want to burn it ('pardon us and how do we rob?'); the Hawk's old hands want to protect it: 'This is our road home.'
after: 秃狼的人被赶跑了，赦书保住了。老弟兄们展开黄绢，找到末尾的一行字，念着念着就哭了：「阳关鹞子，十年守货不动，曾具书言千里号事，虽书未达，其心可悯，特赦。」原来那封信没送到，朝廷却从别处知道了他在等什么。

Bald Wolf's men are driven off and the pardon saved. The old hands unroll it and find a line at the very end, and as they read it aloud they begin to weep: 'The Hawk of Yangguan has guarded goods untouched for ten years, and once wrote concerning the Qianli caravan. Though the letter never arrived, his heart deserves compassion. Specially pardoned.' His letter never reached the court, but somehow the court learned what he was waiting for.

name: 十字墩
Crossroads Mound
before: 四条路在一座土墩下交汇，秃狼的人在墩上设了卡，谁从这里过就问一句「你是谁的人」。答「鹞子的」，挨打；答「秃狼的」，交钱；答「谁的都不是」，扣下。商人们在墩下急得团团转，不知道该怎么答。

Four roads meet below an earth mound, and Bald Wolf's men have set up a checkpoint on top. Everyone passing is asked: 'Whose man are you?' Say 'the Hawk's' and you're beaten. Say 'Bald Wolf's' and you pay. Say 'nobody's' and you're detained. The merchants below are frantic, not knowing how to answer.
after: 秃狼的人被赶下了墩。小柴替商人们出了个主意：以后再有人问，就答「千里号的」。他说这是鹞子手下老弟兄的暗号，十年来谁说出这三个字，阳关的人都会放行。「秃狼不知道这个，」他得意地说，「他来得太晚了。」

Bald Wolf's men are thrown off the mound. Xiao Chai gives the merchants a tip: if anyone asks again, answer 'the Qianli caravan's'. It's the old hands' password, he says. For ten years, whoever spoke those words has been let through by Yangguan's men. 'Bald Wolf doesn't know it,' he says smugly. 'He came too late.'

name: 箭楼沙
Arrow Tower Sands
before: 阳关前的沙地上，鹞子的人用土坯和驼骨搭了三座箭楼，楼上的弓手轮班守着。箭楼之间拉着绳子，绳上挂满铜铃，谁碰了绳子，三座楼的箭就一起射过来。可每到半夜，跪拜的牲口从绳下走过，铃铛响成一片，弓手们却一箭也不放。

On the sands before Yangguan, the Hawk's men have built three arrow towers of mud brick and camel bone, archers on watch in shifts. Ropes strung with bronze bells link the towers; touch one and arrows fly from all three. But every midnight, when the kneeling animals walk under the ropes and the bells clash, the archers never loose a single arrow.
after: 三座箭楼都被拔掉了。绳上的铃铛你们一个个看过去，没有一个是「千」字铃。被俘的弓手说，鹞子不许用那些铃，说那些铃得原样还回去，还给骆驼的主人。「主人不回来，」他说，「铃就挂在仓里，不响。」

All three towers come down. You check the bells on the ropes one by one; none bears Qian. A captured archer says the Hawk forbids using those bells: they must be returned as they are, to the camels' owners. 'Until the owners come back,' he says, 'the bells hang in the storehouse, silent.'

name: 黄羊阵
Gazelle Stampede
before: 这伙大漠响马有个狠招：把成群的黄羊从草滩那头赶过来，几百只黄羊横冲直撞，冲乱了商队，他们再趁乱劫货。今天他们又赶来一群，远处尘土飞扬，大地都在抖。他们说，这招只能白天用：天一黑，黄羊群就不听赶，自己往阳关那边绕。

These desert raiders have a vicious trick: they drive whole herds of gazelles across the grassland so hundreds come stampeding through a caravan, then loot in the chaos. Today another herd is coming, dust boiling up, the ground shaking. The trick only works by day, they say: after dark the herds won't be driven, and wander off toward Yangguan on their own.
after: 你们闪到一边让过黄羊群，迎头冲向后面的响马，把他们打散了。领头的说，连野黄羊都绕着阳关走，夜里在故垒外头远远站着，不敢近也不肯走。「那地方有东西压着，」他摸着胸口说，「不是鬼，是一笔欠了没还的东西。」

You step aside for the gazelles and charge the raiders behind, scattering them. Even the wild gazelles circle Yangguan, their leader says, standing far off outside the old fort at night, not daring to approach, not willing to leave. 'Something weighs on that place,' he says, touching his chest. 'Not a ghost. Something owed and never repaid.'

name: 阳关集
Yangguan Market
before: 阳关故垒脚下有一片集市，从前关里的粮食、关外的石料都在这里交易。如今秃狼的人收「保护钱」，每个摊子交一成，粮商没了利，石匠也不来了。集市空了一半，剩下的摊主都在看你们，又不敢多看，怕被阳关上的人瞧见。

At the foot of the old Yangguan fort lies a market where grain from inside the pass and stone from the frontier once changed hands. Now Bald Wolf's men collect 'protection money', a tenth from every stall. The grain dealers have lost their profit and the stonemasons stopped coming. Half the market is empty, and the remaining stallholders glance at you, but not too much, for fear of being seen from the fort.
after: 收保护钱的人被打跑了，集市活了过来：粮商卸下了粮车，石匠运来了石料，拿粮食换石头，一天九千斤。卖胡饼的老汉悄悄说，十年前千里号在这里补粮，账房先生亲手称的，称完了说「够了」，第二天一早又跑回来，脸都白了，说「少算了一车」。可那时商队已经进了沙海。那天夜里，阳关上的骆驼第一次跪下。

The protection collectors are driven off and the market comes alive: grain carts unload, stonemasons haul in stone, grain for stone at nine thousand catties a day. An old flatbread seller says quietly that ten years ago the Qianli caravan restocked grain here. The bookkeeper weighed it himself and said 'that's enough', then came running back at dawn, white-faced: 'I'm a cartload short.' But the caravan had already entered the Sand Sea. That night, the camels at Yangguan knelt for the first time.

name: 生祠坡
Living Shrine Slope
before: 坡上新盖了一座小庙，庙里供的是秃狼本人的泥像，塑得比他本人英俊三倍，匾上写着「新鹞子」。秃狼的人逼着附近的牧民每天来上香，说以后阳关姓秃。牧民们一边磕头一边小声骂，泥像的鼻子已经被人偷偷掰掉了。

A new little shrine on the slope houses a clay statue of Bald Wolf himself, three times handsomer than the man, under a plaque reading 'The New Hawk'. His men force the herders to come and burn incense daily: Yangguan will belong to Bald Wolf now. The herders curse under their breath as they kowtow, and someone has secretly snapped off the statue's nose.
after: 秃狼的人落荒而逃，牧民们一拥而上把泥像推倒了。一个老牧民说，鹞子十年来从不许人给他立庙，有人送过他一块匾，他拿去垫了马槽：「我是看门的，看别人寄存的东西，哪有看门的受香火。」没了鼻子的泥像脑袋，被孩子们当球踢了。

Bald Wolf's men flee in disgrace and the herders topple the statue. In ten years, an old herder says, the Hawk never let anyone build him a shrine. Someone once gave him a plaque and he used it to prop up a manger: 'I'm a gatekeeper, minding things others left with me. Gatekeepers don't get incense.' The noseless clay head becomes the children's football.

name: 蜃影滩
Mirage Flat
before: 正午的沙滩上，天边浮着一队人影，一个牵一个往西走，走得极慢，怎么也走不远。附近的人说那是千里号的蜃影，十年来天天正午都出现。秃狼的人在蜃影下面埋伏，专抢被蜃影引过来的人。小柴说，鹞子以前每天正午都一个人骑马到这里，看着蜃影坐一个时辰。

At noon on the flat, a line of figures floats on the horizon, hand in hand, walking west, very slowly, never getting far. The locals say it's the mirage of the Qianli caravan, appearing every noon for ten years. Bald Wolf's men lie in ambush beneath it, robbing anyone it lures out. Xiao Chai says the Hawk used to ride here alone every noon and sit watching the mirage for two hours.
after: 埋伏的人被打跑了。你们站在鹞子常坐的那块石头边上看蜃影，数了数，二百九十九个人影，最后一个人影隔着很远的一段路，一个人追在后面，手里抱着一本书。正午一过，蜃影就散了。

The ambushers are driven off. You stand by the stone where the Hawk used to sit and watch the mirage. You count: two hundred and ninety-nine figures, and far behind them, across a long gap, one more, alone, hurrying after them with a book in his arms. As noon passes, the mirage fades.

name: 沙书塾
Sand School
before: 一棵胡杨树下，一个老秀才教牧民的娃娃识字。娃娃里有个叫墨墨的小姑娘，什么都记：哪天谁从这里过、带着什么旗、往哪边去，记在一本自己缝的小簿子上，记得比驿站还全。秃狼的人听说了，要抢她的簿子，老秀才张开胳膊挡在前面，手里只有一根树枝。

Beneath a poplar an old scholar teaches the herders' children to read. Among them is a little girl called Momo who writes everything down: who passed, when, under what banner, which way, in a little book she sewed herself, more complete than any post station's. Bald Wolf's men have heard and come to take it. The old scholar spreads his arms in front of her, armed only with a stick.
after: 秃狼的人被打跑了。墨墨翻开簿子：这三天，秃狼的人一队队往鹞子仓去了，共四百二十七个。她说她爹当年跟一个路过的账房学记账：「什么都记下来，就不会算错。」她想了想，又补一句：「可他自己还是算错了。」

Bald Wolf's men are driven off. Momo opens her book for you: in the last three days, Bald Wolf's troops have marched toward the Hawk's storehouse in band after band, four hundred and twenty-seven in all. She learned record-keeping from a bookkeeper, she says. 'My dad says ten years ago a bookkeeper passed by and taught him: write everything down, and you'll never get your sums wrong.' She thinks a moment, then adds: 'But he still got his wrong.'

name: 运水道
Water Run
before: 阳关故垒缺水，鹞子的人每天从远处的泉眼运水上去，水囊上都盖着鹞子的印。秃狼的人在半路截水，想把阳关渴垮，押水的老弟兄正跟他们拼命。被截下的水囊扔了一地，有的已经被刀划破，水渗进沙里，冒着一缕缕白气。

The old Yangguan fort is short of water, so the Hawk's men haul it daily from a distant spring, every skin stamped with his seal. Bald Wolf's men are ambushing the run to make Yangguan die of thirst, and the old hands escorting it are fighting for their lives. Captured skins lie everywhere; some have been slashed and the water seeps into the sand, steaming faintly.
after: 秃狼的人被打散了，水保住了大半。一个押水的老弟兄说，鹞子自己每天只喝一碗，剩下的倒进帐外的石槽，给那些跪着的骆驼喝。石槽边上刻着一行字：「替主人饮之。」

Bald Wolf's men are scattered and most of the water saved. The Hawk drinks only one bowl a day himself, an old escort says; the rest goes into a stone trough outside his tent for the kneeling camels. Beside the trough is carved a line: 'Drink, on your masters' behalf.'

name: 蜃市摊
Mirage Stall
before: 正午时分，一片晃动的热气里会冒出一个摊子，摊主的脸看不清，卖的东西却样样是真的：刀、盐、毡子、铜器。人都说这是蜃楼里的商人。可最近摊子总被一伙兵痞围着，他们要摊主交出「蜃楼里的金子」。摊主在热气里晃来晃去，就是不肯露面。

At noon a stall appears in the shimmering heat, its keeper's face impossible to make out, though everything he sells is real: blades, salt, felt, copperware. People say he's a merchant from the mirage. Lately a gang of rogue soldiers keeps surrounding the stall, demanding the keeper hand over 'the gold of the mirage'. He wavers in and out of the haze and won't show himself.
after: 兵痞被赶跑了，摊主从热气里走了出来：一个瘦小的走私客，靠着热浪里的影子做了十年买卖。他佩服你们，愿意拿货跟你们换。他说他十年前就在这里摆摊，记得清清楚楚：骆驼跪下，不是从商队走的那天，是从账房先生一个人追进沙海的那天夜里开始的。

The soldiers are driven off and the keeper steps out of the haze: a small, wiry smuggler who has traded for ten years using the shadows in the heat. Impressed by you, he's glad to trade. He had a stall here ten years ago, he says, and remembers clearly: the camels started kneeling not on the day the caravan left, but on the night the bookkeeper chased after them into the Sand Sea alone.

name: 假坟岗
False Grave Mound
before: 荒坡上一座新坟，坟前天天有个汉子跪着哭，哭得撕心裂肺，说里面埋的是他老娘。可附近的牧民说他娘还活着，在关里卖豆腐。原来坟里埋的是秃狼抢来的赃物，准备打下阳关以后用来收买人心，那个哭坟的是专门守坟的，哭了三个月，嗓子都练出来了。

A fresh grave on a barren slope, and every day a man kneels before it weeping his heart out, saying his old mother lies there. But the herders say his mother is alive and selling tofu inside the pass. The grave holds Bald Wolf's loot, saved to buy loyalty after he takes Yangguan, and the mourner is its guard. Three months of weeping have given him quite a voice.
after: 守坟的被打跑了，你们挖开坟，里面果然是一箱箱的赃物。小柴看了直摇头：「秃狼拿这些去收买鹞子的老弟兄？他们连鹞子仓里的千里号货都不碰，会要这个？」赃物你们分还给了附近被抢的人家。

The grave guard is driven off and you dig it open: crate upon crate of loot. Xiao Chai shakes his head. 'Bald Wolf thinks he can buy the Hawk's old hands with this? They won't even touch the Qianli goods in the storehouse. You think they'd want this?' You return the loot to the families it was taken from.

name: 篝火滩
Bonfire Flat
before: 每逢月圆，四方的牧民都会聚到这片草滩上烧篝火、跳舞、换东西。往年鹞子也会来，独眼蒙着黑布，跳得比谁都难看，却跳得最久。今年鹞子没来，秃狼的人骑着马冲了进来，踢翻火堆，抢走姑娘们的银饰，说以后篝火会是他们的「收贡会」。

Every full moon, herders gather on this grassland for bonfires, dancing and trading. In past years the Hawk came too, his blind eye under a black cloth, dancing worse than anyone and longer than anyone. This year he didn't come, and Bald Wolf's men gallop in, kick over the fires, snatch the girls' silver, and announce the gathering is now their 'tribute fair'.
after: 秃狼的人被打跑了，银饰还了回去，篝火重新燃起来，牧民们拉着你们跳到天亮。一个老人说，鹞子跳舞的时候总是朝着西边，跳完了就坐着发呆。「他说他跳的是送行的舞，那年没来得及跳。」

Bald Wolf's men are driven off, the silver returned, the fires relit, and the herders dance with you until dawn. When the Hawk danced, an old man says, he always faced west, and afterwards sat staring into space. 'He said it was a farewell dance. He never got to dance it that year.'

name: 斗鸡场
Cockfighting Pit
before: 一伙秃狼的人在这里挖了个土坑斗鸡，一只鸡头上绑着黑布，叫「鹞子」，一只脑门拔光了毛，叫「秃狼」，坑边押满了赌注，赌的是阳关这回谁赢。附近村子的鸡被抢得一只不剩，连打鸣的都没有了，村里人早上都睡过了头。

A gang of Bald Wolf's men has dug a cockfighting pit here. One rooster has a black cloth tied over its head and is called 'Hawk'; the other has had its crown plucked bald and is called 'Bald Wolf'. Bets are piled round the pit on who wins at Yangguan. The local villages have lost every bird, not even a rooster left to crow, so everyone oversleeps.
after: 斗鸡的人被打跑了，鸡装进筐里送回了村子。那只蒙黑布的「鹞子」，赌场上一次都没输过。第二天天还没亮，村子里此起彼伏全是鸡叫。被俘的人说，赌鹞子赢的比赌秃狼的多，「连秃狼的人心里都没底。」

The gamblers are run off and the chickens taken home in baskets. The black-hooded 'Hawk' never lost a single fight. Next morning before dawn, the village rings with crowing. More bets were on the Hawk than on Bald Wolf, a captive admits. 'Even Bald Wolf's own men aren't sure of him.'

name: 夜哨沙
Night Watch Sands
before: 阳关外的最后一道夜哨，几个弓手轮班守着，可他们值夜不看外面，看里面：鹞子吩咐过，半夜要盯着大帐外的骆驼，看它们跪下来的时辰，一天不落记在一根木杆上。木杆上刻满了道道，密密麻麻，像一本账。

The last night watch outside Yangguan, kept by a few archers in shifts. But they don't watch outward; they watch inward. The Hawk has ordered them to keep an eye on the camels outside his tent at midnight and record the hour they kneel, every single night, notched on a wooden pole. The pole is covered in notches, dense as a ledger.
after: 哨兵被打倒，那根木杆被你们带走了。数一数，三千六百多道，十年，一天没落。最后几道刻得特别深，像是刻的人手在抖。鹞子也在记账，记的是他自己欠下的那一笔。

The sentries go down and you take the pole. Over three thousand six hundred notches: ten years, not one night missed. The last few are cut especially deep, as if the hand was shaking. The Hawk keeps accounts too, it seems. What he records is his own debt.

name: 废烽寨
Ruined Beacon Fort
before: 戈壁上一座废弃的烽燧，墙厚、有水窖、四面看得远，是落草的好地方。这里的匪寨换了一茬又一茬，墙上用炭条写满了前几任寨主的名号。这一年阳关不稳，各路流寇听说鹞子快不行了，都往这一带聚，新来的这一伙正忙着把自己的名号写上墙。

An abandoned beacon tower on the gobi, thick-walled, with a cistern and views in every direction: an ideal bandit roost. Gang after gang has held it, and the walls are covered in charcoal scrawls of past chiefs' names. With Yangguan unsteady this year, drifters have flocked here on rumours that the Hawk is failing, and the latest lot is busy adding their names to the wall.
after: 这一伙也被赶走了，名号只写了半个字。只要阳关一天不安稳，就总会有新的流寇闻风而来，在墙上写下新的名字。到时候，再来一趟就是。

This lot is driven off too, leaving half a name on the wall. As long as Yangguan stays unsettled, new drifters will keep coming at the rumour, and new names will go up. When they do, you'll just come back.

name: 逃卒坡
Runaway's Slope
before: 坡下的草丛里躲着一个从阳关出来的老喽啰，腿上中了一箭，后面追着几个秃狼的人。他看见你们的旗子，拼命爬过来，嘴里喊：「我有话要带给你们！是鹞子的话！」秃狼的人刀已经举起来了，要灭他的口。

In the grass below the slope hides an old underling from Yangguan, an arrow in his leg, a few of Bald Wolf's men on his heels. Seeing your banner, he crawls desperately toward you, crying: 'I've got a message for you! It's from the Hawk!' Bald Wolf's men already have their blades raised to silence him.
after: 秃狼的人被打退了。老喽啰喘着气说，是鹞子派他出来的：「鹞子说，要是有挂着千字旗的人往西来，叫我告诉他们，阳关上有人等了十年，等着有人来问一句：那年你为什么放他们过去。」

Bald Wolf's men are beaten back. Panting, the old underling says the Hawk sent him. 'The Hawk said: if people under the Qian banner come west, tell them someone at Yangguan has waited ten years for someone to ask him one question: why did you let them through that year.'

name: 羊倌店
Shepherd's Inn
before: 古道边一间小小的车马店，店里只有一个老奶奶和她的孙子阿吉。阿吉十二岁，替全村放羊。上个月一个半夜，三十七只羊自己撞开栅栏，跟着一串路过的骆驼往阳关走了，再也没回来。阿吉天天哭着往外跑，几个兵痞嫌他吵，把他关进了柴房。

A tiny roadside inn run by an old grandmother and her grandson Aji. Aji is twelve and herds the whole village's sheep. One midnight last month, thirty-seven of them broke through the fence on their own and followed a passing line of camels toward Yangguan, and never came back. Aji has run out crying every day since, and some rogue soldiers lodging here locked him in the woodshed for the noise.
after: 兵痞被赶走，阿吉从柴房里冲出来拉住你们：「别人家的牲口天亮就回来，我的羊没回来！一定是被人截了。路上的刺上挂着羊毛！」老奶奶叹气，往你们包里塞了一包干粮。

The soldiers are driven out and Aji bursts from the woodshed and grabs your sleeve. 'Everyone else's animals come back at dawn, but mine didn't! Someone must have caught them. There's wool on the thorns along the road!' His grandmother sighs and tucks a packet of food into your bag.
first: 兵痞的铺盖里藏着几十斤炒米、一袋马料、两张狐皮，还有一只做工很好的银手镯，老奶奶一眼认出是她年轻时被人抢走的嫁妆。

In the soldiers' bedding: dozens of catties of fried rice, a bag of horse feed, two fox pelts, and a finely made silver bracelet the grandmother recognises at once, her own dowry, stolen when she was young.
pass: 阿吉每次都远远跑出来迎你们，非要带你们去看他的羊。老奶奶蒸一锅奶馍馍，一人两个，还要你们捎几个在路上吃。
Aji always runs far out to meet you and insists on showing you his sheep. His grandmother steams a pot of milk buns, two each, and makes you take a few more for the road.

name: 挂毛棘
Wool Thorns
before: 古道两边的骆驼刺上，果然一路挂着白花花的羊毛。阿吉跟在你们后面一棵一棵地数。羊毛一直挂到一个路口，路口驻着一大伙沙匪刀手，地上的蹄印到这里乱成一团，一半往阳关去，一半拐进了沙地。阿吉认得出来：「那只瘸腿的走路是歪的！」

Sure enough, white tufts of wool cling to the camel thorn on both sides of the road. Aji follows behind, counting bush by bush. The wool leads to a fork where a large band of sand-bandit blades is camped, and here the hoofprints tangle: half head on toward Yangguan, half turn off into the sand. Aji knows them: 'The lame one walks crooked!'
after: 刀手被打散了，被俘的一个说，那夜他们在路口截下了跟着骆驼走的羊，本想献给秃狼，后来交给了西边沙地里的「剪毛场」。阿吉一听「剪毛」两个字，脸都白了：「它们会冻死的！」

The blades are scattered. A captive says that night they caught the sheep following the camels at the fork, meaning to present them to Bald Wolf, but handed them over to 'the shearing yard' in the sands to the west instead. At the word 'shearing', Aji goes white: 'They'll freeze to death!'

name: 苜蓿庄
Alfalfa Farm
before: 一片绿油油的苜蓿地，是阳关的马吃的草料，鹞子每年按价收购，从不拖欠。秃狼的人占了庄子，把苜蓿一垛垛码起来，说要断了阳关的草料，让鹞子的马饿着肚子打仗。地里的苜蓿没人割，眼看着要老了，庄户们急得团团转。

A lush alfalfa field that feeds the horses of Yangguan; the Hawk buys at a fair price every year and never pays late. Bald Wolf's men have seized the farm and stacked the hay, meaning to cut off Yangguan's fodder so the Hawk's horses go into battle hungry. Nobody's cutting the standing crop, which is going to seed, and the farmers are frantic.
after: 秃狼的人被赶跑了，庄户们抄起镰刀下地，一天割完一大片。老庄主说，鹞子收草料，每年都多付一车的钱，说是「替一个少算了一车粮的人补上」。庄主的小孙女编了个苜蓿花环，挂在你们的旗杆上。

Bald Wolf's men are driven off, and the farmers take up their sickles and cut a whole field in a day. Every year, the old farmer says, the Hawk pays for one cartload more than he takes, 'making up for a man who was a cartload of grain short'. The farmer's little granddaughter weaves an alfalfa wreath and hangs it on your flagpole.
first: 秃狼的人码好的草垛里藏着二十多袋精豆料、一箱铜钱、几匹抢来的绸子，还有一张画着阳关马厩位置的草图。
Hidden in the stacked hay: over twenty sacks of fine bean feed, a chest of coins, a few bolts of stolen silk, and a sketch marking the stables at Yangguan.
pass: 庄户们每次都给你们的马装满一车最嫩的头茬苜蓿，临走还送一罐苜蓿花蜜。
Every time, the farmers load a cart with the tenderest first-cut alfalfa for your horses, and send you off with a jar of alfalfa honey.

name: 鹞子仓
Hawk's Storehouse
before: 阳关故垒北边一条死沟里藏着鹞子仓。秃狼带着他最精锐的人马终于打到了这里，守仓的老弟兄只剩十几个，个个带伤，仍挡在仓门前。仓门上插着一面旗：「非令不开」。秃狼骑在马上狂笑：「鹞子起不来了，今天这仓是我的！」

The Hawk's storehouse lies in a blind gully north of the old Yangguan fort. Bald Wolf and his best troops have finally fought their way here. Only a dozen of the old hands guarding it remain, all wounded, still blocking the door beneath a flag: 'Not to be opened without orders.' Bald Wolf laughs from his saddle: 'The Hawk can't get up. Today this storehouse is mine!'
after: 秃狼的精锐被打垮了，秃狼本人被老弟兄们捆成了一团。仓门开了，里面码着三百副驼鞍、三百只铜铃，一尘不染，墙上挂着一块牌子：「千里号寄存，回程取。」守仓的老弟兄说：「鹞子十年来天天擦一遍。他说这些不是他的，是他欠的。」

Bald Wolf's elite is broken and the old hands truss up Bald Wolf himself. The doors open on three hundred camel saddles and three hundred bronze bells, without a speck of dust, and a board on the wall: 'Left by the Qianli caravan. To be collected on return.' 'The Hawk has polished them every day for ten years,' says an old guard. 'He says none of it is his. It's what he owes.'

name: 剪毛场
Shearing Yard
before: 沙地里一圈木栅栏，栅栏里堆着小山一样的羊毛。一伙沙匪正挥着大剪子剪羊毛，剪完的羊光溜溜地在风里发抖。阿吉趴在沙丘上数了半天，急得直跺脚：「这些都不是我的！我的羊呢？」剪毛的沙匪听见动静，拎着剪子就扑了过来。

A ring of palisade in the sand holds a small mountain of wool. A gang of sand bandits is shearing with great shears, and the shorn sheep shiver naked in the wind. Aji lies on a dune counting for ages, then stamps his feet: 'None of these are mine! Where are mine?' Hearing the noise, the shearers charge, shears in hand.
after: 剪毛的沙匪被打跑了，羊毛分给了被剪的羊的主人。被俘的人说，阿吉那批羊没在这里剪：「大哥不让剪，说那批羊是跟着千里号的骆驼走的，不能动。在更西边的沙窝子里。」

The shearers are driven off and the wool shared among the owners of the shorn sheep. A captive says Aji's flock wasn't sheared here. 'The boss wouldn't allow it. Said that flock walked with the Qianli camels and mustn't be touched. They're in a sandy hollow further west.'

name: 义子坡
Foster Son's Slope
before: 阳关脚下最后一道坡，守着一伙年轻的骑手，都是小柴从小一起长大的兄弟。他们拦住你们，不让上坡：「我们爹病着，谁也不许去惊他。」小柴站在你们这边，低着头不说话。骑手们看着他，眼睛都红了：「小柴，你带外人来打爹？」

The last slope below Yangguan is held by a troop of young riders, the brothers Xiao Chai grew up with. They block your way: 'Our father is ill. Nobody disturbs him.' Xiao Chai stands on your side, head down, saying nothing. The riders look at him with reddened eyes: 'Xiao Chai, you've brought outsiders to fight our father?'
after: 年轻的骑手们输了。小柴这才开口：他是鹞子捡来的孤儿，坡上这些兄弟也都是。「我带你们来，不是打他，」他说，「是他等了十年，等不动了。你们替那些人来，他才能把话说出来。」兄弟们让开了路。

The young riders lose. Only then does Xiao Chai speak: he's an orphan the Hawk took in, and so are all his brothers here. 'I didn't bring you to fight him,' he says. 'He's waited ten years and can't wait any longer. Only if you come in those people's place can he finally say what he has to say.' His brothers stand aside.

name: 沙窝羊圈
Hollow Sheepfold
before: 沙窝深处一个红柳编的羊圈，圈里传出一片咩咩声。阿吉一听就哭了：「是它们！」守圈的是一伙沙匪，为首的是个满脸横肉的大汉，手里拿的却不是刀，是一根放羊的鞭子。他挡在圈门口：「谁也别想动这些羊。」

Deep in the sandy hollow stands a sheepfold woven from tamarisk, full of bleating. Aji bursts into tears: 'It's them!' A gang of sand bandits guards the fold, led by a big hard-faced man holding not a blade but a shepherd's whip. He blocks the gate: 'Nobody touches these sheep.'
after: 那大汉蹲在圈门口抹了把脸。他原是阳关给鹞子放牲口的，最懂这些牲口。他说那年夜里，鹞子让千里号的骆驼跪下卸了货，存进仓里，说回程再装。「骆驼一直跪着，是在等人来给它们装货，好回家。羊跟着骆驼，也想回家。」阿吉冲进圈里一只只叫着名字，三十七只，一只不少，还多了十一只小羊羔。阿吉想了想，塞一只给大汉：「你也放得好。」大汉红着眼说，跟你们一起去阳关，见鹞子最后一面也好，见他放下也好。

The big man squats at the gate and wipes his face. He used to tend the Hawk's animals at Yangguan, and knows them better than anyone. That night, he says, the Hawk had the Qianli camels kneel to be unloaded, the goods stored away to be reloaded on the way home. 'The camels are still kneeling, waiting for someone to load them so they can go home. The sheep followed the camels. They wanted to go home too.' Aji rushes in calling them by name: thirty-seven, not one missing, plus eleven lambs. After a moment's thought, he gives one to the big man: 'You herd well too.' Red-eyed, the man says he'll come with you to Yangguan, whether to see the Hawk one last time or to see him finally let go.

name: 阳关故垒
Old Yangguan Fort
before: 阳关故垒立在古道尽头，城墙塌了一半，城楼上插着一面独眼鹞子的黑旗。鹞子的老弟兄们三路排开，没有一个是秃狼的人。大帐外，一百多峰骆驼齐刷刷跪着，头朝西，石槽里的水满着，仓门开着。鹞子一头白发，独眼蒙着黑布，扶着刀站在城楼上，看了你们的旗子很久：「十年了。来吧，看看你们配不配问。」

The old Yangguan fort stands at the end of the road, walls half fallen, the one-eyed hawk on its black banner. The Hawk's old companions are drawn up three columns wide; not one is Bald Wolf's. Outside the great tent, a hundred and more camels kneel in rows, heads west, the trough full, the storehouse open. White-haired, his blind eye under black cloth, the Hawk leans on his blade on the tower and studies your banner a long time. 'Ten years. Come on, then. Let's see if you've earned the right to ask.'
after: 鹞子败了，坐在台阶上开了口：「那年我拦下千里号要路钱，账房翻开账本给我看一路的欠账，说回程一并还。我说沙海里刀没用，赶回了护卫，扣下货当押。他说粮够，我信了。第二天他发觉少算一车，抱着账本一个人追进去了。」他把仓门钥匙交给你们：「这是我算错的一笔。沙海是马贼王的地盘，听说那里有个女人，也在找会算账的人。」帐外的骆驼，一峰接一峰站了起来。

Beaten, the Hawk sits on the steps and talks. 'I stopped the Qianli caravan for a toll. The bookkeeper showed me his ledger, every debt along the road, all to be repaid on the way home. I said blades are no use in the Sand Sea, sent the guards back, kept the goods as pledge. He said the grain was enough, and I believed him. Next day he found he was a cartload short, and went in after them alone with the ledger.' He hands you the storehouse keys. 'That's the sum I got wrong. The Sand Sea is the Bandit King's. They say a woman there is looking for someone who can keep accounts too.' Outside, one by one, the camels rise.

name: 猫儿营
Cat Camp
before: 这伙沙匪的头领凶名在外，砍人从不眨眼，可他抢了一个胡商的波斯猫以后整个人都变了：走到哪儿都抱着猫，开会的时候猫趴在他头上。他说营里的骆驼、马、狗，半夜全跑去阳关跪着，只有这只猫不去，夜里陪着他，他才睡得着。

This bandit chief has a fearsome name and cuts men down without blinking, but since he stole a Persian cat from a foreign merchant he's a changed man, carrying it everywhere; in councils it sits on his head. Every camel, horse and dog in his camp runs off to kneel at Yangguan at midnight, he says. Only the cat stays, keeping him company, and only then can he sleep.
after: 头领被打败时还紧紧护着猫。猫却跳出来蹭了蹭你们的腿。你们把猫还给了胡商，胡商听说了这事，笑着说：「猫不认谁欠了谁，所以睡得着。牲口认，人也认。」头领哭得比丢了寨子还伤心。

Even in defeat the chief shields the cat, but it leaps down and rubs against your legs. You return it to the merchant, who laughs when he hears the story: 'A cat doesn't care who owes whom, so it sleeps. Animals that care don't. Nor do people.' The chief weeps harder than if he'd lost his fort.
